architecture.mechanism: Integration of dry-contact sensors and inertial measurement to maintain signal integrity under dynamic motion conditions.
architecture.intervention: Apply dry-contact adhesive strips with integrated inertial dampening materials between the console mounting brackets and the headliner substrate to absorb vibration and increase friction without adding bulk that obstructs visibility or interferes with wiring.
architecture.expected_effect: The console attachment will resist detachment forces caused by vehicle motion and vibration while maintaining clearance for dash-camera wiring and driver forward visibility.
architecture.falsification_test: Subject the modified console assembly to standardized road vibration profiles (ISO 16750-3) and sudden deceleration events; failure is defined as any displacement greater than 2mm or loss of secure attachment.
